game.name: Bulletstorm (Germany)(En,De)
game.desc: Bulletstorm is a first-person shooter for Xbox 360. Based in a futuristic utopian universe, the game follows Grayson Hunt and Ishi Sato, two members of a paramilitary organisation working for a futuristic confederation called Dead Echo. But the duo will end up on the planet Stygia, home to dangerous mutants.
